notes.problem: Dowel support, mockup phone on a wedge, flat green band.
notes.fix: Squared caliche block, phone flat on the plank plane facing the glass, world scaled grain, camera lower so the bulb sits on cobalt.

notes.problem: Empty sorter beside a wireframe phone on a flat green band, no focal.
notes.fix: Push in low on the planks so the sorter fills half the frame and the phone screen is modelled, held at the frame edge.

notes.problem: Reuses frame 3's glass on a dowel; the phone's dashed box reads as a placeholder.
notes.fix: Change camera and scale from frame 3; a finished phone screen with no detection drawn.
Lower and push the camera, run a drag scuff from the slot to the pulled box.

notes.problem: Even cubes on a flat void, dead lower half.
notes.fix: Tilt the tray off the bottom edge and set the lifted cube large and warm in the foreground.

notes.problem: Top loaded, cubes float on a flat field.
notes.fix: Tilt down so the tray fills two thirds and the lifted box is large in the foreground beside its socket.

notes.problem: Generic road with uncountable posts and empty sky.
notes.fix: Camera at post height, fence diagonal from the lower left so all 19 are large, type over the dark ground.

notes.problem: No dominant subject, a thin fence under empty sky.
notes.fix: Drop the camera low beside the first post so the posts recede from a post filling the left third, type in the sky above the far posts.

notes.problem: Decal flies, dark blob, lavender plastic block.
notes.fix: Flies standing on rims with contact shadows, delete the blob, brushed metal with a lit chamfer.

notes.problem: Flies are dark blobs on lavender with a dark wash behind the tray.
notes.fix: Camera in 25 percent, warm key and rim on each fly, contact shadow under the tray only.

notes.problem: Marching ants stream, pail trap, acacia tree.
notes.fix: Depth banded near flies with wings, funnel cone and lure cap, a twisted multi trunk mesquite.

notes.problem: Generic tub and a speck thin stream at 432 px.
notes.fix: Pull in so the trap fills half the frame and the stream passes larger through the foreground.

notes.problem: Mannequin in a flat blue room.
notes.fix: Worker at the bench with forceps under a warm lamp pool, warmer walls.

notes.problem: Monochrome blue room, mannequin, catch unreadable at feed size.
notes.fix: Crop to the front rows at macro and put gloved hands sorting under a warm lamp in the foreground.
